description: The CRM of the brand's HighLevel sub-account. action search_contacts (q, or email / phone for the exact one; limit 1-100, page) | get_contact (contactId) | create_contact / update_contact (firstName, lastName, name, email, phone, company (create only), assignedTo, tags, source, website, timezone, address1, city, state, postalCode, country, dnd, fields { custom field id or key: value }) | log_activity (contactId, body, subject, channel, direction, occurredAt; type task with dueAt makes a task, anything else a note) | list_opportunities (q, stage, pipelineId, status open/won/lost/abandoned/all, assignedTo, contactId, limit, page) | get_opportunity (opportunityId) | update_opportunity (opportunityId + stage, pipelineId, status, amount, assignedTo, name, fields) | list_pipelines (with their stages) | list_users (the assignedTo values). Writes are read back. An action the app's permission does not cover is refused by name. Free.

assignedTo.description: the HighLevel user the contact or opportunity is assigned to (a list_users id)

status.description: open, won, lost or abandoned (all, for list)

name: highlevel_crm
title: HighLevel CRM (contacts, opportunities, pipelines)
